# SurgeGrid AI — Real-Time Electrical Grid & Flood Resiliency Console

> Operational intelligence, real-time meteorological tracking via Google DeepMind WeatherNext 3, satellite flood inundation models, and automated line tripping defense protocols for Chennai's 286 TNEB electrical substations.

SurgeGrid AI is an open-source, civic crisis-resilience platform for monitoring and mitigating electrical infrastructure hazards during severe weather, cyclones, and urban flooding across Greater Chennai.

## Web Console & Applications
- [SurgeGrid AI Web Console](https://surgegrid.nammamap.in/): Interactive geospatial dashboard visualizing Chennai's 286 electrical substations, 2,678 feeder circuits (3,335 with surveyed street geometry), and 65,557 surveyed distribution transformers (DTRs).
- [Full Technical Specification](https://surgegrid.nammamap.in/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive technical architecture, physical grid topology, and operational protocols for LLMs and autonomous agents.
- [Sitemap](https://surgegrid.nammamap.in/sitemap.xml): Search engine and crawler index of console endpoints.

## Disaster Resilience & Statutory SOPs
- [TNSDMA Statutory Disaster SOPs](https://surgegrid.nammamap.in/): Statutory SLAs and emergency power shutoff procedures based on flood inundation thresholds.
- [GCC Ward Disaster Directory](https://surgegrid.nammamap.in/): Civic disaster committees, 200 Greater Chennai Corporation wards, relief shelters, and rapid response personnel.
